text.tspan: Share of cancer deaths by cancer type 2023
The estimated percentage of deaths from different types of cancers as a proportion of all cancer-related deaths.

tspan.tspan: The 'Other' category includes cancer types with fewer than 200,000 deaths worldwide in the latest year of data.
